title: High-Throughput Culture and DNA Isolation Methods for Aspergillus fumigatus
author: Reyes Márquez, Auxier, et al.
materials: Malt extract agar (MEA) medium (see recipe), 55° to 60°C
A. fumigatus spore suspension or unique colony-forming unit from agar plate
PBS-0.05% Tween-20 buffer (see Current Protocols article: Fraczek et al., 2019; see recipe)
96-deep-well plate, 2 ml, pyramid bottom, 44-mm height, sterile (Greiner, cat. no. 780271)
2-mm cotton swabs (Heinz Herenz Hamburg, cat. no. 31032238) or tungsten inoculation needle

steps.title: Prepare 96‑well mini slants
steps.instruction: Set up mini slants in a 96‑deep‑well plate format to enable high‑throughput culture of Aspergillus fumigatus isolates.

steps.title: Inoculate mini slants
steps.instruction: Inoculate each mini slant with the respective A. fumigatus isolate according to the experimental design.

steps.title: Incubate and harvest spores
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated mini slants, then harvest the resulting spores to prepare a spore suspension that can be used for amplicon screening, PCR‑quality DNA isolation, or glycerol‑stock preparation for storage at –80 °C.

steps.title: PCR‑quality DNA isolation (heat‑shock)
steps.instruction: Apply the modified heat‑shock protocol (based on Fraczek et al. 2019) to the spore suspension to obtain genomic DNA suitable for PCR, agarose‑gel electrophoresis, Sanger sequencing, or Nanopore amplicon sequencing, without requiring a –80 °C freezer step.

steps.title: High‑purity DNA from mycelial mats
steps.instruction: Inoculate spore suspensions into liquid medium in the 96‑well format, grow mycelial mats, then isolate high‑quality genomic DNA using paramagnetic beads; the DNA is appropriate for Nextera Flex library preparation (paired‑end reads of 300–400 bp) and can be stored at –80 °C for later use.

steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 2 % (v/v) Triton X‑100, 1 % (w/v) SDS, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM Tris·HCl (pH 8.0), and 1 mM EDTA (pH 8.0); autoclave the solution for 15 min at 121 °C; store ≤1 month at room temperature (short‑term) or ≤6 months at 4 °C (long‑term).
